title: Three Nights and One Short Score
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：music　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 music 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the musician ① played the music that no listener in the hall would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the night. The ② music, meaning the song itself and not the score, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; music, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of music in that hall had the same short score beside it, and the ④ music at the far piano, meaning the note they kept for the children to play and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Music, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the musician said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the music was the whole of the matter, meaning the feeling and not the song. The ⑥ music, meaning the feeling and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; music, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both song and a feeling. He said the feeling is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ music had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short score. The ⑧ music of the whole thing, the musician wrote in December, was one hall and three nights of recording; music, he said, is either the note at the far piano or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ music I remember is the music recorded in the programme, which closed in 1972 and is still recorded as the quietest in the hall. ⑩ Music, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all music, she said, is a feeling that has agreed to look like song. She said the feeling was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 音乐（指音乐厅里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 音乐（指那段音乐本身，与薄薄的乐谱相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the music 演奏这一段音乐
D. n. 音乐（指留给孩子们弹的那一个）
E. n. 音乐之事（抽象总称，指一处音乐厅的音乐之事）
F. n. 音乐（指节目单里写到、被记载的那一段）
G. n. 音乐、情致（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情致（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the music that no listener in the hall would have recorded
The music, meaning the song itself and not the score
Every sort of music in that hall
the music at the far piano
the music was the whole of the matter
the music had become a line in a programme
The music of the whole thing

answers.why: play the music 意为“演奏这一段音乐”，1965 年那位乐师把音乐厅里没有一位听客肯记载的一段音乐做了一遍。
music 意为“音乐”，指那段音乐本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
music 意为“音乐”，指音乐厅里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。
music 意为“音乐”，指最远那张琴凳的留给孩子们弹的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
music 意为“音乐、情致”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段情致就是那件事的全部。
music 意为“情致”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段音乐，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
music 意为“音乐”，指节目单里写到、被记载的那一段，到 1970 年这一段成了节目单里的一行。
music 意为“音乐之事”，乐师十二月写道，整件事的音乐之事是一处音乐厅和三个夜晚的记载。
music 意为“音乐”，我记得的是节目单里记载过的那一段，1972 年奏完了，至今仍被说成音乐厅里最安静的一段。
music 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，音乐是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的音乐。

那段音乐，指的是那段音乐本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。（music）
那处音乐厅里每一种音乐旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。（music）
最远那张琴凳那段音乐，指的是他们留给孩子们弹的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（music）
叔叔说这段情致就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那段音乐。（music）
